dataset: OECD Database on Export Restrictions on Staple Crops (OECD contribution to the AMIS Policy Database)
coverage: Export restrictions from 2007 on wheat, maize, rice, soybeans (AMIS countries)
fetch_note: Live unattended download from oecd.org is blocked by Cloudflare bot protection. This workbook is the public OECD/AMIS export-restrictions database (Detailed+Aggregated sheets; ~472 KB, matching the site listing of ~516 KB). To refresh: open official_oecd_page in a browser and use “Download the database (XLSX)”.
